verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships AI features, including an AI code reviewer, AI-powered pipeline workflows and Rovo, so auditing AI agent sessions is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of audit logs for AI agent sessions or actions, nor any attribution of those actions to the user who triggered them. Centralized pipeline visibility and permission controls are adjacent features, not an AI-action audit trail.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can audit AI agent sessions and actions attributed to the user who triggered them
